name: labs/ad-sdl__sdl-simulation
title: SDL Gazebo mobile manipulator (UR5e arm)
intro: SDL Gazebo mobile manipulator (UR5e arm), adapted from ad-sdl/sdl-simulation. It reads `read_arm_status` and `read_nav_status`; runs `arm_pose_goal`, `base_pose_goal`, `left_gripper_position` and `right_gripper_position`. `arm_pose_goal`: publish one geometry_msgs/Pose arm target; the receipt reports the values sent and no execution acknowledgement is available. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
